title: Use variables for repeatable requests
summary: A Postman variable can hold a reusable value such as a base URL. The selected scope controls which value is used.
introduction: A Postman variable can hold a reusable value such as a base URL. The selected scope controls which value is used. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use variables for repeatable requests
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Postman variable can hold a reusable value such as a base URL. The selected scope controls which value is used.
Changing the variable lets a collection target a different approved environment without editing every request.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why you must inspect the active environment before sending.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not accidentally switch a harmless practice request to a live write environment.
For more detail later, use this [Postman further reading](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/overview/).

seo.title: Postman: Use variables for repeatable requests
seo.description: Learn about use variables for repeatable requests in Postman. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
